clause: Raster color-management consumption: assign/convert profile, soft-proof, gamut, picker, spot [STU-RAS-034]

scope.summary: Consume the 14.8 color pipeline (ColorEngine MT-019) at the raster surface WITHOUT forking it: working-space profile settings (RGB/CMYK/Gray/Spot) + mismatch policies as saved presets; Assign-Profile (retag without changing values) and Convert-to-Profile (convert values with rendering-intent choice); embed-profile-on-save; soft-proof (proof setup / proof colors) previewing an output condition without converting; gamut warning; a color picker (HSB/RGB/Lab/CMYK/hex with out-of-gamut warning); and spot-color library selection from installed color books. Soft-proof and OCIO are also exposed as adjustments (MT-058).
acceptance_criteria: assign/convert profile, soft-proof, gamut warning, multi-model picker, spot books
consumes ColorEngine; does not fork the CMM
expected_tests: live: Assign-Profile changes tag without changing pixel values; Convert-to-Profile with a rendering intent changes values; soft-proof preview + gamut warning render without converting the document
live: color picker returns HSB/RGB/Lab/CMYK/hex with an out-of-gamut flag

risk_if_missed: No color management at the raster surface, or a forked CMM diverging from 14.8.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
